correctness.rationale: Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus4 and differential valuations yield a complete basis. Cartier coefficient extraction gives A(t)=-7t^4(t-1)^4P(t), B(t)=3P(t), P=(t-2)(t+1)(t+9); with t≠0,1 both vanish exactly at three harmonic roots, or give a rank-two invertible Cartier block whose stable image has dimension2. Exhaustive exact finite-field modular point counting for 17 rational parameters and S3 orbit enumeration are replayed from verify.py; all F361 counts distinguish the four orbits, with unique maximal orbit size3. No unproved inference from finite sampling to algebraic-closure classification.

value.rationale: This is the first small inert characteristic of a natural special one-dimensional genus-four cyclic-cover family where the known Newton table permits both generic and basic strata. The exact sharp harmonic locus, global a-number gap, four distinct rational isomorphism classes, and unique quadratic-field maximal class resolve natural arithmetic-geometric classification questions with exact reproducible data; they are not merely a normalization or rephrasing of known existence.
